vo_open.text: This worm can grow to nearly three meters.
And you'd never see it coming.

vo.text: It's the bobbit worm. It buries its whole body in the sea floor.
vo.cap: The *bobbit worm.* It buries its *whole body* in the sea floor.

vo.text: Only its antennae stick out. And it waits.
vo.cap: Only its *antennae* stick out. And it *waits.*

vo.text: When prey comes close, it strikes, with jaws that can snap some prey in half.
vo.cap: Then it *strikes.* Jaws that can snap prey *in half.*

vo.text: The longest one ever measured was two hundred ninety-nine centimeters.
That's longer than the tallest human who ever lived.
And fossil burrows show they've hunted like this for twenty million years.
vo.cap: Fossil burrows: *20 million years* of hunting like this.
